context: Bedtime in Sho's room. Yumiko sits on the edge of his bed as he settles in, his small worries surfacing the way they often do at night.
purpose: tender bedtime — mother soothing a six-year-old's nighttime worries

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: もう寝る時間だよ。電気消すね。
lines.en: It's already bedtime. I'll turn off the light.
lines.style: Warm maternal hush, slowing the cadence intentionally, voice softening to bedtime register throughout.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おかあさん…ちょっとだけ、いて。
lines.en: Mom… just a little bit, stay.
lines.style: Small breathy six-year-old request, voice trailing off shyly, the request quiet but earnest underneath.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: Maternal attentive softness, the question opening space without pressing, real listening in the tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Tiny six-year-old voice, almost whispered, slight worried catch on the trailing-off vowel at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: Is there something you're worried about?
lines.style: Gentle maternal probe, careful pacing leaving room to answer, no rush behind the question at all.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 明日、お友達と話せるかな…。
lines.en: Tomorrow, I wonder if I can talk to my friend…
lines.style: Soft trailing six-year-old worry, voice dropping further on the hesitation, small real anxiety threaded in.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 大丈夫だよ。きっと話せる。
lines.en: It'll be okay. You'll definitely be able to.
lines.style: Steady maternal reassurance, soft warm certainty wrapping each word, conviction without forcing it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Single quiet six-year-old check, faint hope rising in the voice, vulnerability bare in the small word.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。一緒に練習したじゃない？
lines.en: Yes. We practiced together, didn't we?
lines.style: Warm maternal reminder, slight smile in the voice anchoring him in shared memory, gentle and sure.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Small settled six-year-old exhale, voice softening into sleep already, contented and quietly secure.
